exposure: management of all stages of labour
cohort: 75 cases of PPH at a tertiary center in Patna, India, 13 of whom were booked cases and 62 of whom reported directly in labor room or were referred from primary and community health centers.
finding: Hemorrhage is the leading cause of maternal mortality and morbidity worldwide, and effective measures such as providing antenatal care, safe hospital deliveries, and timely referral of high-risk pregnancies are expected to reduce PPH.
